notes.title: Thank You For All The Great Feedback!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917163/5eb0fa9bb75e7afbfea939af7318d70f1efe69ce.png[/img]

Hi Restaurateurs!

The team at Hidden Chest Studios would like to thank everyone who shared their feedback with us from the Halloween ’24 Open Playtest – it has been truly insightful and motivating.

There have been over 800 downloads, far more than we anticipated! For that we must give special thanks to the following Youtubers for introducing the Midwest 90: Rapid City playtest to everyone:

•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@TheGeekCupboard]The Geek Cupboard[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@orbitalpotato]Orbital Potato[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@DanFieldGaming]Dan Field[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@DieselDesigns]Diesel Design Gaming[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@floppysims]Floppy Sims[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@PlayfulPlaytests]Playful Playtests[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@hawk1377]Hawksu[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@shirlierox]Shirlierox[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@VividGamingGG]Vivid Gaming GG[/url]
•	[url=https://www.youtube.com/@DadsGamingAddiction]Dad's Gaming Addiction[/url]

We are humbled by all the positivity and enthusiasm we received from the Playtest. Your support means everything to us, and we will do our very best to deliver an amazing new experience with Midwest 90: Rapid City.

As a side note, you might have noticed our Halloween ’24 Open Playtest is still available.

You also might have noticed that we haven’t updated our Playtest since, well, November 2024.

Our previous announcement had informed that Patch 3 was the last for the playtest, and there’s a good reason for that – it’s just a Playtest and not an Early Access build with a live road map.

The objective for the Halloween ’24 Open Playtest was to collect feedback for us to learn how to make a better game.

It wasn’t meant to be a representation of the final product.

However that being said, we are keeping this version of the Halloween ’24 Open Playtest available for download until further notice. This is for curious gamers who want to have a sneak peek at what we’re working towards. So please share this steam page with you friends!

We are now working towards our next development milestone – a Steam Next Fest demo and we couldn’t have come this far it without your contribution.

Thanks again and Stay Hungry for the next update!

p.s Thanks for the Wishlists too!

notes.title: Midwest 90: Rapid City - Halloween '24 Open Playtest
notes.content:
Happy Halloween!

It's been a while since we have had an open playtest for Midwest 90: Rapid City, over a year actually. 

We're a tiny team who faced a lot of challenges throughout the year but we kept going and we'll keep going until M90 is ready.

We wish could have made this announcement sooner, we released the playtest on the 24th of October and haven't set an end date for the playtest but we have this patch schedule that you can refer to for the moment. 

We still have a lot to do for the game but with your feedback we can finally move out of the alpha stage and aim for the finish line. 

Thanks for all the support, we are 2230 wishlist and we hope we can grow that in the next few months so that we can secure some financial help from either a publisher or an investor. 

Finger crossed and looking forward to your feedback!

Thanks again

Hidden Chest Team
